title: Facial Recognition & Biometric Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your facial recognition exposure risk. Assess surveillance threats, biometric data collection, and get protection recommendations.
description: Evaluate your exposure to facial recognition surveillance and biometric data collection. Get personalized risk assessment and actionable steps to protect your biometric privacy from unauthorized scanning and database storage.

formula: let baseRisk = 0; const locationMultiplier = location === 'urban' ? 30: location === 'suburban' ? 15: 5; const publicExposure = (publicSpaces / 80) * 25; const socialRisk = socialMedia === 'frequent' ? 20: socialMedia === 'moderate' ? 12: socialMedia === 'limited' ? 5: 0; const workplaceRisk = workplace === 'extensive' ? 15: workplace === 'basic' ? 8: 0; const activismBonus = activism ? 15: 0; const protectionReduction = protections === 'advanced' ? 0.3: protections === 'moderate' ? 0.15: protections === 'basic' ? 0.05: 0; baseRisk = locationMultiplier + publicExposure + socialRisk + workplaceRisk + activismBonus; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(baseRisk * (1 - protectionReduction)))); const riskLevel = riskScore >= 70 ? 'A+': riskScore >= 50 ? 'B+': riskScore >= 30 ? 'C+': 'D+'; const exposureEstimate = Math.round((publicSpaces / 10) * (location === 'urban' ? 3: location === 'suburban' ? 1.5: 0.5)); return { riskScore, riskLevel, exposureEstimate };

educational.methodology: This calculator assesses facial recognition exposure based on location surveillance density, public space usage, digital footprint, workplace systems, and existing protection measures. Risk factors are weighted according to surveillance deployment patterns and biometric data collection practices.
tips: Use a privacy-focused browser to limit online tracking that builds biometric profiles
Wear sunglasses and face masks in high-surveillance areas like airports and city centers
Review and tighten social media privacy settings to prevent photo scraping
Research local facial recognition policies and opt-out where legally possible
Consider anti-surveillance clothing with infrared-blocking patterns for high-risk situations

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Maximum exposure to facial recognition systems. Implement advanced countermeasures and consider relocating if possible.
